I replied to Sofia in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is owned by Kwame Adjei-Rowe, so she should send the ticket to him.

Bettina's Oct 14 correction says Pellucid stays with Kwame and nothing changes there. Her covering next week is for Pellow Home Living, Sofia's account, while Sofia is on site at Hagerstown.

I also told Sofia how to tell the two apart. Tickets on the Gulf Coast terminal rows are Pellucid and go to Kwame. Tickets on the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments are Pellow, which stays with Sofia and has Bettina covering next week.
